method_note: The image is partitioned into a 4×4 grid (16 binary features: region present/absent, masked with the image's own mean colour). shap.KernelExplainer estimates each region's Shapley value — its fair marginal contribution to the model's confidence, averaged over all coalitions of present/absent regions, with mathematical guarantees (efficiency: the 16 values sum exactly to confidence(full image) − confidence(fully masked)). Run with 150 coalition samples per model against the real deployed MLflow pyfunc artifacts, via the actual inference contract — not a mock or a simplified proxy.
efficiency_check: For all three models the 16 Shapley values summed to within 0.00pp of confidence(full) − confidence(fully masked) — the efficiency axiom holds exactly, confirming these are genuine Shapley values rather than an uncontrolled approximation.
caveat: Computed once on one sample image as a demonstration, not a comprehensive bias/fairness audit across the dataset. A single region accounting for nearly all of the attributed confidence is the expected, desired result — it shows the model is keying on the real defect rather than a background shortcut; it does not by itself establish fairness across aircraft, lighting, or defect size.
